message:
The other day, I found myself staring at a pile of mismatched batteries in my junk drawer. You know, the kind that seems to multiply when you’re not looking? I decided to take a few minutes to organize them into a little box. 

Fast forward to last night when the winds picked up, and we were under a storm warning. I felt pretty smug when I realized I could easily grab the right batteries for our flashlights. 

A small win, sure, but it felt nice to be ready instead of scrambling in the dark. 

Have you had any little wins in your preparedness journey? I'd love to hear your tips!
